item.description:
📝 The gathering reflects mounting frustration after countries agreed at COP28 to transition away from fossil fuels but made little progress. Just across the road from the site of the first international conference on transitioning away from fossil fuels, in Colombia, oil tankers routinely unload at the Pozos Colorados terminal, with its large tank farm. Countries first agreed at COP28 in Dubai in 2023 to “transition away from fossil fuels,” but made little progress on it.
